# Benchmark summary (generated by `jamrecall_bench.report`)

Tolerances: onset ±50 ms, pitch ±50 cents; offset-aware F1 additionally requires offset within max(50 ms, 20% of note). Micro-averaged over notes. Parameters chosen by onset F1 on GuitarSet dev only.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| Basic Pitch (ONNX), mono post-process | 0.883 / 0.931 / **0.906** | 0.789 | 8.2 | 97.8% / 0.1% | 0.994 | 0.873 |
| Basic Pitch (ONNX), raw polyphonic | 0.842 / 0.932 / **0.885** | 0.768 | 8.3 | 96.9% / 1.0% | 0.965 | 0.770 |
| TEST-ONLY fixture (ignores audio) | 0.003 / 0.002 / **0.002** | 0.000 | 26.5 | 1.1% / 9.2% | 0.004 | 0.004 |
